title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode8 A Howl Mary Play

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You and Max are up soon, Shinonome.
I'm getting so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, you look more nervous than me.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys...!
Thanks for coming to cheer us on!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks for coming.
Also, I didn't expect to see you here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been wondering how today was going to go. Also, it's a great chance to gather more data on dogs. I'm looking forward to seeing how you do, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, this is quite an atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
All the dogs and their owners look really excited...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome, you guys should start heading over towards the court...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, those with the highest cumulative scores after the first two rounds advance to the finals?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: That's right. Which is why it's important to get off to a good start by scoring a lot of points during the first... Oh, hey!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: <Next, we have Mr. Shinonome and Max!>

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: They practiced making five mid-range catches during the allotted time...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: And they should be able to advance to the finals if they get all five...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your partner's watching, so let's go out there and win!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Nice throw, Shinonome!
That's right at the height and distance Max likes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Next, he needs to get the disc back from Max.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He did it! He got the disc back from Max!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they seem to be working in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
There's his second throw...!
Yes, nice catch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's three in a row!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
*Nod*
If they can keep this up...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's make it four in a row, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, the disc's being blown off course...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(It fell to the ground...
If only I'd sensed that gust sooner...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We need to make all five catches. Now there's no chance of us making the finals...)

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: It's not over until it's over, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Right. It's too soon to give up...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As much as I want to make up for our fourth throw, we don't have time to do six. That means our next one is gonna be our last.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going deep for our last throw, Max!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's so far!
Is Max gonna be able to catch it...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I think he's trying to maximize the number of points they can score.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But they won't get any if Max doesn't catch it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I threw it even further that first time!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean you want me to...?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yes. After he's pulled off a nice play, he always sits like this and asks for pets.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Congratulations on winning third place, Shinonome, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks... But I feel kinda bad about not winning.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?!
You advanced to the finals on your first try. That by itself is a huge accomplishment.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys were so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Thank you again for doing this, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: You made sure Max's efforts didn't go to waste... As a result, this ended up being a great experience for both me and him.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
So, thank you!
And thank you all for practicing with us and cheering them on... I really appreciate what you did!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you as well. This ended up being quite a valuable experience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so happy that you were able to find a way to believe in Max.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm so glad you got a chance to see him compete, Ishihara...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Huh...?! Haha. I'm grateful for you too, pal. Thanks for running like I was out there with you.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
What you did was so cool!
I'm proud to have a partner like you!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: So, next time, we're gonna win! Together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(We didn't win today...
But I feel like I was able to help them.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going deep for our last throw, Max!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe we became friends...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the looks of it, I have a feeling that you'll do just fine with other dogs now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Well, I mean...
I feel more comfortable around them now compared to bef—

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'm so sorry! I hope my dog didn't startle you...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Nope. This is still gonna take a while.)
